items.title: An OpenAI Employee Allegedly Used a Chatbot to Help Plant a Recording Device at the Office
items.summary: Chatbot prompts reveal the engineer’s alleged efforts to set up a covert listening device days before one was found in a meeting room used by high-level executives.
items.author: Paresh Dave, Maddy Varner, Caroline Haskins

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Tell British Lawmakers: Regulate Us
items.summary: AI leaders joined whistleblowers and security leaders at a sweeping parliamentary session, while a few hundred meters away Britain’s spy chief warned AI could be used to create new bioweapons.
items.author: Ben Gartside

items.title: Wikipedians Believed AI Would Come and Go. They Were Wrong
items.summary: In a world of AI Overviews, Wikipedia usage declines. But the real loss may be far more existential than website traffic.
items.author: Richard Cooke

items.title: The Biggest Pro-AI Super PAC Network Has Poured Millions Into Nevada Shell Companies
items.summary: Backed by Silicon Valley titans, Leading the Future has raised huge sums to promote pro-AI candidates on both side of the aisle.
items.author: Tess Owen
